description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application, implementing the main home screen. It includes setup for top navigation, banner carousel, and content rails, along with mock data generation. The code manages layouts, focus behavior, and adaptive sizing for different screen resolutions.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the home screen, managing layout, focus, and interaction of top navigation, banner, and content rows.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data class representing individual media content items with id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row of content, with a title and list of ContentItems.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the Fragment's layout and initializes binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components including brand text, top navigation, banner rail, and content rails.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Builds styled brand text with color spans and accessibility label.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Initializes the top navigation RecyclerView with categories and focus handling.

methods.name: setupBannerRail
methods.description: Configures the banner carousel RecyclerView, sizing, snapping, and focus behavior.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Creates mock content rows and initializes the vertical content list.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Nullifies binding to avoid memory leaks.
